tagline: Long‑established multi‑speciality tertiary hospital in Calicut

description: Baby Memorial Hospital (BMH) is a long‑established private multi‑speciality tertiary hospital on Indira Gandhi Road (Arayidathupalam) in central Kozhikode. The group started in 1987 as a modest 52‑bed facility and has grown into a large tertiary centre serving North Kerala and neighbouring regions.

BMH houses broad clinical services across cardiology, cardiothoracic surgery, oncology (now organised as the NAVA Cancer Institute at Kozhikode), neurology and neurosurgery, hepatobiliary and liver transplant services, neonatology and many other departments. The hospital presents diagnostic and therapeutic capacities including MRI, PET‑CT, cath labs, nuclear medicine and a blood bank, as listed in its NABH scope.

The hospital has held NABH accreditation (Certificate No. H-2008-0015) with documented accreditation cycles; the NABH scope document records accreditation valid from 2021-12-29 through 2025-12-28 and a scope update on 2024-04-25 (confirm current status with NABH or the hospital). BMH also promotes international patient services and runs a cluster of hospitals across North Kerala.
highlights: Founded 1987; grew from a 52‑bed facility to a major tertiary centre.
NABH‑listed facility (Certificate H-2008-0015; scope document shows validity to 2025-12-28—confirm current status).
Wide specialist services: cardiology, cardiothoracic surgery, oncology, neurosurgery, liver transplant and neonatology.
Comprehensive diagnostics: MRI, PET‑CT, cath lab, nuclear medicine and an in‑house blood bank.
Active events and service launches in 2025–2026 (NAVA Cancer Institute, PRISM paediatric clinic).

sections.heading: Background
body: Baby Memorial Hospital began in 1987 as a small, community‑focussed facility and expanded into a multi‑speciality tertiary hospital serving Kozhikode and North Kerala. Over the decades the group adds regional hospitals (Kannur, Payyanur, Vadakara, Thodupuzha and others) and positions itself as a referral centre for complex care.

sections.heading: Clinical strengths and services
body: BMH lists a broad NABH scope covering anaesthesiology, cardiology, cardiothoracic surgery, critical care, medical and surgical oncology, hepatobiliary surgery and liver transplant, neurology and neurosurgery, neonatology and paediatrics, orthopaedics, urology (including renal transplant), interventional radiology, nuclear medicine and a wide range of diagnostic labs and imaging.

Recent centre launches at the Kozhikode campus (for example the NAVA Cancer Institute and PRISM — a clinic for rare paediatric disorders) show ongoing investment in integrated cancer care and specialised paediatric services. Confirm which specific procedures (e.g. transplants, bone‑marrow programmes) are available at the Kozhikode campus before planning travel for treatment.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: BMH sits on Indira Gandhi Road at Arayidathupalam in central Kozhikode. Use the hospital’s official website or the contact page to book appointments, find specialist clinics and access the international patients desk. For urgent care call the emergency number listed on the hospital website.

If you need to rely on accreditation or specific high‑risk procedures, verify current NABH status and departmental capabilities with the hospital or NABH (the public NABH scope document records accreditation through 2025-12-28 and scope updates). Carry ID, referral papers and prior investigation reports for specialist consultations.

latest.text: BMH Kozhikode launches PRISM clinic — a dedicated multidisciplinary clinic for rare paediatric genetic, skeletal and muscular disorders (inaugurated October 22, 2026).

BMH Kozhikode formally launches the NAVA Cancer Institute, a comprehensive oncology centre integrating medical, surgical and radiation oncology with nuclear medicine and hematology services (February 5, 2026).

NABH scope update recorded (new scope entry includes Clinical Hematology and many clinical and diagnostic services); the NABH scope document lists validity from 2021-12-29 through 2025-12-28—confirm current NABH status before relying on it.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Year‑round; weekdays for routine specialist appointments, any time for emergency care.
visitorInfo.howToReach: Located on Indira Gandhi Road (Arayidathupalam) in central Kozhikode. Reach by taxi or auto-rickshaw from Kozhikode Railway Station or city bus stops; Calicut International Airport (Karipur) offers regional and national flights — arrange taxi or airport transfer to Kozhikode city.
etiquette: Confirm current NABH accreditation and specific departmental availability (e.g., transplant programmes) with the hospital before travel.
Use the hospital website’s appointment or international patients pages for pre‑registration and to check consultant clinic days.
Bring prior medical records, ID and referral letters to speed consultations.
For visiting relatives, ask the hospital about visitor policies and available parking or nearby accommodation; public parking exists across the road.
